title: Show information for a specific PCI device
summary: Use lspci with the -s flag and a device ID to see details for only one specific piece of hardware, such as a particular network card or graphics adapter.

steps.explain: Run lspci with the -s flag followed by the PCI device ID (e.g., 00:02.0) to filter the output.
steps.expect: Information for only the specified device.

placeholders.name: DEVICE_ID
placeholders.description: The PCI address of the device, e.g., 00:02.0
